title: Types & Shadows
scripture: Exodus 12; Numbers 21; Hebrews 9; John 1; Genesis 14; Exodus 16; Genesis 6

steps.clue: A lamb without blemish was chosen. Its blood was placed on the doorposts, and judgment passed over the homes marked by the blood. What is the Old Testament shadow?
Israel was bitten by fiery serpents. Moses lifted something up so that those who looked would live. What was lifted up?
God told Israel to make a place where He would dwell among them. What was this earthly structure called?
When John saw Jesus, he used the name of this animal to identify Him.
A mysterious king-priest appeared to Abraham with bread and wine. Who was he?
Israel was hungry in the wilderness, and God provided food from heaven. What was it called?
One family was preserved while judgment came upon the world. What was the means of preservation?
